docs.abstract: A Colorado Democrat turned Republican, he was the only Native American during three terms in the House and 12 years in the Senate. He was also a judo expert and an Olympian.

headline.main: Ben Nighthorse Campbell, Native American Senator, Dies at 92

docs.abstract: While some people slow down as they get older, or just try to maintain, these athletes went looking for a challenge in Brazilian jiu-jitsu.

headline.main: Fighting Father Time, Hand to Hand
